bio: Surrounded by the town wall, the Amtshaus boasts a lovely location in Freinsheim's old town, which is well worth a visit. The courtyard with its idyllic terrace leads to this chic restaurant, where you will notice a white cross vault supported by columns. Chef Swen Bultmann cooks classic French dishes that are made from fine ingredients and inspired by the seasons. The food is accompanied by an appealing and extensive selection of wines. There is also accommodation – in the tasteful guestrooms, as in the restaurant itself, the decor harmoniously incorporates modern design into the historical setting....
